blocks.orig: Kwanza Resort enjoys a beachfront location in Kizimkazi, on Zanzibar’s south coast. Here, it boasts dozens of well-accommodated en-suite rooms, suites, bungalows, and villas with either a private jacuzzi on the veranda, a shared pool, or a completely private pool, allowing you to walk right into the water from your patio! The rooms are bright and elegantly adorned with traditional Zanzibarian artwork and wooden furniture, giving you that fresh, coastal feel. Excellent dining can take place in The Cave, a fine dining restaurant offering you refined traditional African dishes, or in restaurant Jua, where you can choose from a variety of international dishes. Furthermore, you enjoy a glass of wine or a sunset cocktail in one of the three bars spread across the resort to cap off your day!
blocks.html: On Zanzibar’s south coast, in Kizimkazi, Kwanza Resort sits right on the beach. It has dozens of well-equipped en-suite rooms, suites, bungalows and villas, with a private jacuzzi on the veranda, a shared pool or a fully private pool, so you can step from your patio straight into the water! Bright and elegant, the rooms are decorated with traditional Zanzibarian art and wooden furniture, which gives them a fresh coastal feel. For an excellent meal you can go to The Cave, a fine dining restaurant serving refined traditional African cuisine, or to restaurant Jua, with its wide choice of international dishes. To round off your day, have a glass of wine or a sunset cocktail at one of the three bars around the resort!
